name: F-Zero X

needs.hint: Put a .z64, .v64 or .n64 dump in Roms/N64 (any name) or as App/FZeroX/rom.z64.
needs.title: F-ZERO X

about: Native N64 port built from the F-Zero X decompilation. No emulation: runs on the Mini's CPU with a software renderer. Save states (9 slots + auto save). First start takes about a minute.
